name: Sword
effect: Close-range anti-program attack. High damage to a single ICE.

name: Virus
effect: Lower burst but applies damage-over-time to the target ICE.
flavor: It teaches the ICE to eat itself.

name: Armor
effect: Reduces incoming ICE damage by a flat amount while loaded.
flavor: A skin of cached nonsense between you and the burn.

name: See-Through
effect: Reveals the contents of the next floor before descending (improves initiative vs hidden ICE).

name: Stealth
effect: Attempt to bypass an ICE without engaging (opposed vs ICE perception).
flavor: You were never on this floor.

name: Banhammer
effect: Heavy two-slot anti-program weapon; cracks high-DEF black ICE.
flavor: Brings the whole vault down on one process.

name: Worm
effect: Specialist barrier-breaker; big to-hit bonus, modest damage.
flavor: Finds the one bad assumption in the wall and lives there.

name: Shield
effect: Heavy two-slot damage reduction; survival deck for black-ICE dives.
flavor: A bunker you carry into the fire.

name: Eraser
effect: Scrubs your trail; can lower the alarm/heat built up on a floor.
flavor: You leave the system cleaner than you found it. Cleaner than you were.

name: Speedy Gonzalvez
effect: Extra NET action speed; better initiative against waiting ICE.
flavor: The whole architecture seems to slow down around you.
